subject: Refactored protobuf generation code (cmake) (#172)
reason: The change is purely a CMake build refactor: it replaces the generic protobuf_generate() custom-command machinery with configure-time execute_process calls to protoc (plus a timestamp-based skip and extra status messages) in protobuf_generate.cmake and the CMakeLists.txt files that call it. No .proto file, C++ source, or module runtime code changes; the protoc invocations produce the same generated sources with the same include paths, and any generation failure is a configure-time FATAL_ERROR caught when the runner builds the module. There is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to reach, so no
